name: retry-state-machine finite structural safety checker
material_outcome: PASS iff the retry controller structurally routes stale/rate-limit conditions to reconstruction/wait and contains no explicit manual-rescue branch.
equivalence_scope: This checker substitutes for a script/CI execution only for this finite declarative invariant. It does not claim arbitrary build/test equivalence.
decision_rule: PASS only if all ten checks pass; otherwise FAIL and report exact failed ids.
execution_requirements: Only JSON/text fetch plus finite path lookup/comparison. No shell, build system, hosted runner, Codespaces, package registry, external API/model credit or manual user step is required.
